title: Multi-Generation Family with Baby by House, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: An intimate multi-generational family portrait taken outdoors against the horizontal wood siding and window of a residential home. An elderly couple stands on either side: the grandfather wearing a light collared dress shirt and the grandmother sporting round spectacles and a dark floral print dress. In the middle, a young mother with classic 1940s rolled hair and a cardigan holds an infant. The image captures a timeless slice of mid-20th-century American domestic life.
